info.title: infer-runtime aggregate schema source
info.description: Dated Consumer Core for application integration. Every protected Consumer request sends exactly one Infer-Consumer-Contract: infer-runtime.consumer-core@20260813.1. A typed capability request also sends the exact Infer-Capability-Contract selected from the Capability Catalog. Operator resource and provider administration routes are intentionally excluded.

post.description: Submit the supported stateless subset of an OpenAI Responses request. The model field is an infer-runtime intent, not a physical deployment ID.

200.description: Completed response, or an SSE stream when stream=true

schema.description: SSE event/data frames. Provider event types are forwarded after response identity normalization; runtime-generated failures use event: error.

get.description: Get a durable background response owned by the authenticated application.

post.description: Request cancellation of a durable background response.

200.description: Transcription result; text/plain is used when response_format=text

get.summary: Open an experimental duplex PCM transcription session
get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket. The first text frame is session.configure, binary frames carry pcm_s16le audio, and input_audio.commit/input_audio.finish produce revisable transcript events. The current MLX adapter discloses transcription_mode=commit_redecode rather than claiming native incremental ASR.

post.description: Detect overlapping, time-bounded AudioSet events in file audio. Execution is fixed to local-only, offline, with no fallback. Speech presence is independent model evidence and is never inferred from transcript availability.

200.description: Versioned multi-label event detections, coverage, speech evidence, ontology, policy, and model provenance
Generated audio. x-infer-job-id and x-infer-model identify the execution.
Generated audio. x-infer-job-id and x-infer-model identify the execution.

post.description: Experimental synchronous local-only typed image description. The request is not durable background payload.
Experimental synchronous local-only review against a Consumer-owned closed category set.

200.description: Assistant classification proposal; never user feedback
Face boxes and five-point landmarks in decoded input pixels
Normalized text embedding in the paired image space
Materialization receipt; pixel payload remains on leased descriptors

consumerContract.name: Infer-Consumer-Contract
consumerContract.description: Required exactly once with value infer-runtime.consumer-core@20260813.1. Missing, duplicate, or other values return HTTP 426 consumer_core_unsupported.

ConsumerContract.name: Infer-Consumer-Contract
ConsumerContract.description: The only accepted dated Consumer Core identity.

InferModel.description: Logical intent requested by the caller

InferSampleRate.description: Audio sample rate fixed before the first body byte

InferChannels.description: Audio channel count fixed before the first body byte

Error.description: Stable error envelope; code is machine-actionable and message is diagnostic text

error.message: request body does not match the documented schema

schema_version.description: Exactly one immutable schema version per Catalog record. The same capability id may have several records during a migration window.

model.description: Stable intent profile, never a physical deployment ID

metadata.description: The named-routing capability accepts at most one of infer.deployment_ids or infer.model_profile_ids. Its value is an ordered comma-separated list of 1-16 Runtime-owned IDs. The App routing ACL must authorize every ID; the request is a hard narrowing and never expands the App security ceiling.

store.description: Only false or null is accepted

Metadata.description: Application metadata plus documented infer.* routing constraints. Unknown reserved infer.* keys are rejected.

metadata.description: JSON object whose values are strings

class_id.description: Stable class id from the pinned AudioSet class map, never a model output index

artifact_set_sha256.description: Digest of the exact sorted ArtifactStore file set used for execution

status.description: absent requires full coverage and low model evidence; it is never inferred from missing transcript

execution_mode.description: server_stream requires response_format=pcm and returns append-only PCM chunks
